name: select_existing_categories_batch
description: Select the best matching existing learning category for each seller category in the batch

mappings.description: Array of category mappings, one per seller category in the input

seller_category.description: The original seller category being mapped

selected_category_id.description: ID (UUID) of the best matching existing learning category

similarity_score.description: How well the selected category matches (0.0-1.0)

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this category was selected
